status: P1 complete: reranker top-5 selected; P2 data expansion next

baseline.v3_stop_reason: NEI floor 0.477 vs gate 0.40; no test pass spent

test_budget.rule: One final pass for the combined v4 system. No component gets a separate test pass. All components are selected on val. No test-driven tuning.

retrieval_stack.candidate: top-50 hybrid -> bge-reranker-base -> compare top-5 vs top-8; top-5 selected
retrieval_stack.query_generation: optional; two queries per claim, only if the reranker leaves a large retrieval-failure bucket

keep_rule.note: Compare against v1 hybrid val 0.67636 and INSUFFICIENT F1 0.52073.

retrieval_stack.fallback: If the stack misses the keep rule on val, keep v1 retrieval and do not rebuild the expanded caches.

data_expansion.features: rebuild retrieval + NLI for new train claims only
data_expansion.fallback: If 6k plateaus above NEI 0.45, stop the expansion and report.

nei_stage.stage_2: SUPPORTED vs CONTRADICTED on verifiable claims
nei_stage.hard_negatives: delete or swap gold evidence in training rows only

verifier_study.concat_premise: top-3 evidence concatenated as a second NLI input
verifier_study.keep_rule: val macro-F1 improves and INSUFFICIENT F1 does not regress

promotion_gates.brier_max: less than or equal to uncalibrated on the same test rows

notes: P1 retrieval runs first because it changes the feature caches; data expansion is built once on the chosen retrieval.
The reranker is a macro-F1 move; its hybrid val study slightly lowered INSUFFICIENT F1, so it is not assumed to fix NEI.
v4 uses the existing FEVER dataset and paper_dev; no new dataset is introduced.
HaluEval corpus/aggregator work is deferred and not part of the v4 test pass.
Test data is read only in the final P5 pass.
